vrrp_instance_name.description: Name of the VRRP instance (e.g., VI_1, ETH0_VRRP).

interface.description: Network interface to bind to (e.g., eth0, ens33).

vrid.description: Virtual Router ID (1–255); must be unique per LAN segment.

priority.description: Priority (higher = more preferred); MASTER usually has highest.

advert_int.description: Advertisement interval in seconds (VRRP heartbeat frequency).

authentication.description: Optional VRRP authentication block (simple or password auth). Note: Non-compliant with modern VRRP standards.

virtual_ipaddress.description: List of VIPs (IPv4 or IPv6) assigned to the instance (e.g., ['192.168.1.100/24', 'fd2001:db8::1/64']).

preempt_delay.description: Seconds to delay preemption after startup (0 = no delay).

notify_master.description: Path to script to run on transition to MASTER state.

notify_backup.description: Path to script to run on transition to BACKUP state.

notify_fault.description: Path to script to run on transition to FAULT state.

virtual_server.description: List of virtual servers (LVS NAT/DR/TUN mode load-balancing configs).
